sections.heading: Overview
sections.content:
Austrar

Austrar is a level in Maxr3 GDPS, rated as a 2-star Easy level within the Low-Mid tier, featuring straightforward mechanics. Progress and Sections:
0–11%: This section features the Cube, with jumps over single small spikes, accompanied by upward movements before landing.
11–16%: Includes a jump over three spikes--significantly nerfed. 16–24%: Features jumps over single small spikes.
24–32%: Includes a somewhat narrow Wave segment. 32–40%: Features a mini UFO section with structures in a *Flappy Bird* style.
40–50%: You enter a mini Spider section that is somewhat narrow; notably, there is a key here used to collect an invisible coin hidden within the structures.
50–60%: Features simple dual-mode gameplay with two jumps over single spikes.
60–74%: Consists of repeated jumps over single spikes while in a tiny size.
74–88%:Wave Part.
88–100%: At the last ship portal, tiny jumps appear on both the ceiling and the floor--right at the last second--requiring you to keep the ship centered.
